Open and read failures wrap ErrUnreadable; an empty,\n// malformed, or ragged file wraps ErrRejected.\nfunc Read(path string) (*Table, error) {\n\tf, err := os.Open(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %v\", ErrUnreadable, err)\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\tinfo, err := f.Stat()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrUnreadable, path, err)\n\t}\n\tif info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s is a directory\", ErrUnreadable, path)\n\t}\n\treturn parse(path, f)\n}\n\nfunc parse(name string, r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\t// Field-count mismatches are checked here so the diagnostic can name the line.\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"no header record, file is empty\")\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, classify(name, err)\n\t}\n\n\ttable := &Table{Header: trimAll(header)}\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool, len(table.Header))\n\tfor i, h := range table.Header {\n\t\tif h == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"header column %d is empty\", i+1)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[h] {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"header name %q is repeated\", h)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[h] = true\n\t}\n\n\tfor {\n\t\trecord, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, classify(name, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tif len(record) != len(table.Header) {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"line %d has %d fields, header has %d\", line, len(record), len(table.Header))\n\t\t}\n\t\ttable.Rows = append(table.Rows, trimAll(record))\n\t\ttable.Lines = append(table.Lines, line)\n\t}\n\treturn table, nil\n}\n\n// classify maps an encoding/csv error to a rejection when it is a syntax error, and to an\n// unreadable file when it came from the underlying reader.\nfunc classify(name string, err error) error {\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrRejected, name, err)\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrUnreadable, name, err)\n}\n\nfunc rejectedf(name, format string, args ...any) error {\n\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %s\", ErrRejected, name, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))\n}\n\nfunc trimAll(values []string) []string {\n\tout := make([]string, len(values))\n\tfor i, v := range values {\n\t\tout[i] = strings.TrimSpace(v)\n\t}\n\treturn Open and read failures wrap ErrUnreadable; an empty,\n// malformed, or ragged file wraps ErrRejected.\nfunc Read(path string) (*Table, error) {\n\tf, err := os.Open(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %v\", ErrUnreadable, err)\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\tinfo, err := f.Stat()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrUnreadable, path, err)\n\t}\n\tif info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s is a directory\", ErrUnreadable, path)\n\t}\n\treturn parse(path, f)\n}\n\nfunc parse(name string, r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\t// Field-count mismatches are checked here so the diagnostic can name the line.\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"no header record, file is empty\")\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, classify(name, err)\n\t}\n\n\ttable := &Table{Header: trimAll(header)}\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool, len(table.Header))\n\tfor i, h := range table.Header {\n\t\tif h == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"header column %d is empty\", i+1)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[h] {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"header name %q is repeated\", h)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[h] = true\n\t}\n\n\tfor {\n\t\trecord, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, classify(name, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tif len(record) != len(table.Header) {\n\t\t\treturn nil, rejectedf(name, \"line %d has %d fields, header has %d\", line, len(record), len(table.Header))\n\t\t}\n\t\ttable.Rows = append(table.Rows, trimAll(record))\n\t\ttable.Lines = append(table.Lines, line)\n\t}\n\treturn table, nil\n}\n\n// classify maps an encoding/csv error to a rejection when it is a syntax error, and to an\n// unreadable file when it came from the underlying reader.\nfunc classify(name string, err error) error {\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrRejected, name, err)\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %v\", ErrUnreadable, name, err)\n}\n\nfunc rejectedf(name, format string, args ...any) error {\n\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: %s: %s\", ErrRejected, name, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))\n}\n\nfunc trimAll(values []string) []string {\n\tout := make([]string, len(values))\n\tfor i, v := range values {\n\t\tout[i] = strings.TrimSpace(v)\n\t}\n\treturn csvio\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc writeFile(t *testing.T, content string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"data.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn path\n}\n\nfunc TestReadTrimsHeaderAndValues(t Package profile classifies nulls, infers column types, and computes counts, statistics, and frequencies.\npackage profile\n\nimport (\n\t\"regexp\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"time\"\n)\n\n// Column types, in the order InferType tests them.\nconst (\n\tTypeInteger = \"integer\"\n\tTypeNumber  = \"number\"\n\tTypeDate    = \"date\"\n\tTypeBoolean = \"boolean\"\n\tTypeText    = \"text\"\n\tTypeEmpty   = \"empty\"\n)\n\n// nullSpellings are the non-empty values classified as null, compared ignoring case.\nvar nullSpellings = []string{\"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"}\n\nvar (\n\tintegerPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^-?[0-9]+$`)\n\tnumberPattern  = regexp.MustCompile(`^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$`)\n\tdatePattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)\n)\n\n// Column is the profile of one column.\ntype Column struct {\n\tName     string\n\tType     string\n\tRows     int\n\tNulls    int\n\tDistinct int\n\tMin      string\n\tMax      string\n\tSum      string\n\tMean     string\n\tMedian   string\n}\n\n// IsNull reports whether a value is null: empty after trimming, or NA, N/A, or NULL ignoring case.\nfunc IsNull(value string) bool {\n\tv := strings.TrimSpace(value)\n\tif v == \"\" {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tfor _, spelling := range nullSpellings {\n\t\tif strings.EqualFold(v, spelling) {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// InferType returns the first of integer, number, date, boolean, or text that every non-null\n// value satisfies, or empty when no value is non-null.\nfunc InferType(values []string) string {\n\tpresent := nonNull(values)\n\tif len(present) == 0 {\n\t\treturn TypeEmpty\n\t}\n\tif allMatch(present, integerPattern.MatchString) {\n\t\treturn TypeInteger\n\t}\n\tif allMatch(present, numberPattern.MatchString) {\n\t\treturn TypeNumber\n\t}\n\tif allMatch(present, isDate) {\n\t\treturn TypeDate\n\t}\n\tif allMatch(present, isBoolean) {\n\t\treturn TypeBoolean\n\t}\n\treturn TypeText\n}\n\n// ProfileColumn computes the full profile of one column from its trimmed values.\nfunc ProfileColumn(name string, values []string) Column {\n\ttyp := InferType(values)\n\trows, nulls, distinct := countValues(values)\n\tpresent := nonNull(values)\n\n\tcol := Column{\n\t\tName:     name,\n\t\tType:     typ,\n\t\tRows:     rows,\n\t\tNulls:    nulls,\n\t\tDistinct: distinct,\n\t}\n\tcol.Min, col.Max = minMax(typ, present)\n\tif typ == TypeInteger || typ == TypeNumber {\n\t\tcol.Sum, col.Mean, col.Median = numericStats(typ, present)\n\t}\n\treturn col\n}\n\n// countValues returns the row count, null count, and distinct non-null count.\nfunc countValues(values []string) (rows, nulls, distinct int) {\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tif IsNull(v) {\n\t\t\tnulls++\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[strings.TrimSpace(v)] = true\n\t}\n\treturn len(values), nulls, len(seen)\n}\n\n// nonNull returns the trimmed values that are not null.\nfunc nonNull(values []string) []string {\n\tout := make([]string, 0, len(values))\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tif !IsNull(v) {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, strings.TrimSpace(v))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc allMatch(values []string, ok func(string) bool) bool {\n\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\tif !ok(v) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// isDate requires the YYYY-MM-DD shape and a real calendar date, so leap years and month\n// lengths are checked by the standard library.\nfunc isDate(v string) bool {\n\tif !datePattern.MatchString(v) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\t_, err := time.Parse(\"2006-01-02\", v)\n\treturn err == nil\n}\n\nfunc isBoolean(v string) bool {\n\treturn strings.EqualFold(v, \"true\") || strings.EqualFold(v, got != TypeText {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s: InferType(%q) = %q, want %q\", name, values, got, TypeText)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestInferTypeEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string][]string{\n\t\t\"no values\":         nil,\n\t\t\"only empty\":        {\"\", \"  \", \"\"},\n\t\t\"only null spelled\": {\"NA\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\"},\n\t}\n\tfor name, values := range cases {\n\t\tif got := InferType(values); got != TypeEmpty {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s: InferType(%q) = %q, want %q\", name, values, got, TypeEmpty)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileColumnNumericFields(t *testing.T) {\n\tcol := ProfileColumn(\"amt\", []string{\"1.50\", \"-2.25\", \"NA\", \"10.00\"})\n\twant := Column{\n\t\tName: \"amt\", Type: TypeNumber, Rows: 4, Nulls: 1, Distinct: 3,\n\t\tMin: \"-2.25\", Max: \"10.00\", Sum: \"9.25\", Mean: \"3.08\", Median: \"1.50\",\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(col, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ProfileColumn = %+v, want %+v\", col, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileColumnNonNumericBlanksStatistics(t *testing.T) {\n\tcol := ProfileColumn(\"when\", []string{\"2025-01-05\", \"2024-12-31\"})\n\tif col.Sum != \"\" || col.Mean != \"\" || col.Median != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"date column statistics = (%q, %q, %q), want all blank\", col.Sum, col.Mean, col.Median)\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01DnKPC6teKXGRMvV3bVgPjZ","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

profile\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/big\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc TestCountsRows(t *testing.T) {\n\trows, _, _ := countValues([]string{\"1\", \"NA\", \"\", \"3\"})\n\tif rows != 4 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"rows = %d, want 4\", rows)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestCountsNulls(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, nulls, _ := countValues([]string{\"\", \"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\", \"null\", \"x\", \"NAN\", \"0\"})\n\tif nulls != 5 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"nulls = %d, want 5\", nulls)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestCountsDistinct(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, _, distinct := countValues([]string{\"true\", \"TRUE\", \"true\", \"NA\", \"\", \"false\"})\n\tif distinct != 3 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"distinct = %d, want 3 (true, TRUE, false; nulls excluded)\", distinct)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestCountsHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\trows, nulls, distinct := countValues(nil)\n\tif rows != 0 || nulls != 0 || distinct != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"counts = (%d, %d, %d), want (0, 0, 0)\", rows, nulls, distinct)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumInteger(t *testing.T) {\n\tsum, mean, _ := numericStats(TypeInteger, []string{\"10\", \"-3\", \"5\"})\n\tif sum != \"12\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sum = %q, want %q (plain integer)\", sum, \"12\")\n\t}\n\tif mean != \"4.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"mean = %q, want %q\", mean, \"4.00\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\tsum, _, _ := numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.10\", \"0.20\", \"0.30\"})\n\tif sum != \"0.60\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sum = %q, want %q\", sum, \"0.60\")\n\t}\n\tsum, _, _ = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"1.005\", \"1.004\"})\n\tif sum != \"2.01\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sum = %q, want %q (exact 2.009 rounds once)\", sum, \"2.01\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMeanRounding(t *testing.T) {\n\t// 1 + 2 + 2 = 5, 5/3 = 1.666..., rounds to 1.67.\n\t_, mean, _ := numericStats(TypeInteger, []string{\"1\", \"2\", \"2\"})\n\tif mean != \"1.67\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"mean = %q, want %q\", mean, \"1.67\")\n\t}\n\t// 0.125 is exactly half a hundredth and rounds away from zero.\n\t_, mean, _ = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.12\", \"0.13\"})\n\tif mean != \"0.13\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"mean = %q, want %q\", mean, \"0.13\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMeanNegative(t *testing.T) {\n\t// -1.005 is \"9.00\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, _, median := numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"1.00\", \"2.005\"})\n\tif median != \"1.50\" && median != \"1.50\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"1.50\")\n\t}\n\t_, _, median = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.00\", \"0.01\", \"0.02\"})\n\tif median != \"0.01\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"0.01\")\n\t}\n\t_, _, median = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.01\", \"0.02\"})\n\tif median != \"0.02\" {\n\t\t// (0.01 + 0.02) / 2 = 0.015 rounds half away from zero to 0.02.\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"0.02\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNonNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tcol := ProfileColumn(\"word\", []string{\"pear\", \"apple\", \"fig\"})\n\tif col.Median != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want blank for text\", col.Median)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxInteger(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeInteger, []string{\"-3\", \"12\", \"7\"})\n\tif lo != \"-3\" || hi != \"12\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want -3,12 (numeric order)\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeNumber, []string{\"2.5\", \"-10.125\", \"9\"})\n\tif lo != \"-10.13\" || hi != \"9.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want -10.13,9.00\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxDate(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeDate, []string{\"2025-03-01\", \"2024-12-31\", \"2025-02-14\"})\n\tif lo != \"2024-12-31\" || hi != \"2025-03-01\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want 2024-12-31,2025-03-01\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxBoolean(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := []struct {\n\t\tvalues []string\n\t\tlo, hi string\n\t}{\n\t\t{[]string{\"true\", \"TRUE\"}, \"true\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{[]string{\"false\", \"True\"}, \"false\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{[]string{\"FALSE\"}, \"false\", \"false\"},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeBoolean, c.values)\n\t\tif lo != c.lo || hi != c.hi {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"minMax(%q) = %q,%q, want %q,%q\", c.values, lo, hi, c.lo, c.hi)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxText(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeText, []string{\"pear\", \"Apple\", \"fig\", \"apple\"})\n\tif lo != \"Apple\" || hi != \"pear\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want Apple,pear (byte order)\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeEmpty, nil)\n\tif lo != \"\" || hi != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want blanks\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatRatHalfAwayFromZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]*big.Rat{\n\t\t\"0.01\":  big.NewRat(1, 100),\n\t\t\"0.13\":  big.NewRat(125, 1000),\n\t\t\"-0.13\": big.NewRat(-125, 1000),\n\t\t\"2.00\":  big.NewRat(2, 1),\n\t\t\"-0.00\": big.NewRat(-1, 1000),\n\t}\n\tcases[\"0.00\"] = cases[\"-0.00\"]\n\tdelete(cases, \"-0.00\")\n\tfor want, r := range cases {\n\t\tif got := FormatRat(r); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"FormatRat(%s) = %q, want %q\", r.RatString(), got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_0153Jkep1HHHMuPgucmz6dMh","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

*testing.T) {\n\t// Lexical order would put \"10\" before \"9\"; numeric order puts 9 in the middle of 2, 9, 10.\n\t_, _, median := numericStats(TypeInteger, []string{\"10\", \"2\", \"9\"})\n\tif median != \"9.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q (numeric sort)\", median, \"9.00\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, _, median := numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"1.00\", \"2.005\"})\n\tif median != \"1.50\" && median != \"1.50\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"1.50\")\n\t}\n\t_, _, median = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.00\", \"0.01\", \"0.02\"})\n\tif median != \"0.01\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"0.01\")\n\t}\n\t_, _, median = numericStats(TypeNumber, []string{\"0.01\", \"0.02\"})\n\tif median != \"0.02\" {\n\t\t// (0.01 + 0.02) / 2 = 0.015 rounds half away from zero to 0.02.\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want %q\", median, \"0.02\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNonNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tcol := ProfileColumn(\"word\", []string{\"pear\", \"apple\", \"fig\"})\n\tif col.Median != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"median = %q, want blank for text\", col.Median)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxInteger(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeInteger, []string{\"-3\", \"12\", \"7\"})\n\tif lo != \"-3\" || hi != \"12\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want -3,12 (numeric order)\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeNumber, []string{\"2.5\", \"-10.125\", \"9\"})\n\tif lo != \"-10.13\" || hi != \"9.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want -10.13,9.00\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxDate(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeDate, []string{\"2025-03-01\", \"2024-12-31\", \"2025-02-14\"})\n\tif lo != \"2024-12-31\" || hi != \"2025-03-01\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want 2024-12-31,2025-03-01\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxBoolean(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := []struct {\n\t\tvalues []string\n\t\tlo, hi string\n\t}{\n\t\t{[]string{\"true\", \"TRUE\"}, \"true\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{[]string{\"false\", \"True\"}, \"false\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{[]string{\"FALSE\"}, \"false\", \"false\"},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeBoolean, c.values)\n\t\tif lo != c.lo || hi != c.hi {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"minMax(%q) = %q,%q, want %q,%q\", c.values, lo, hi, c.lo, c.hi)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxText(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeText, []string{\"pear\", \"Apple\", \"fig\", \"apple\"})\n\tif lo != \"Apple\" || hi != \"pear\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want Apple,pear (byte order)\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tlo, hi := minMax(TypeEmpty, nil)\n\tif lo != \"\" || hi != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"min,max = %q,%q, want blanks\", lo, hi)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatRatHalfAwayFromZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]*big.Rat{\n\t\t\"0.01\":  big.NewRat(1, 100),\n\t\t\"0.13\":  big.NewRat(125, 1000),\n\t\t\"-0.13\": big.NewRat(-125, 1000),\n\t\t\"2.00\":  big.NewRat(2, 1),\n\t\t\"-0.00\": big.NewRat(-1, 1000),\n\t}\n\tcases[\"0.00\"] = cases[\"-0.00\"]\n\tdelete(cases, \"-0.00\")\n\tfor want, r := range cases {\n\t\tif got := FormatRat(r); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"FormatRat(%s) = %q, want %q\", r.RatString(), got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01HRPPUtqPuEfBTvTWr8CQKA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

parseOutput(t *testing.T, stdout string) [][]string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\trecords, err := csv.NewReader(strings.NewReader(stdout)).ReadAll()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout is not CSV: %v\\n%s\", err, stdout)\n\t}\n\treturn records\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileHeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runCLI(t, writeCSV(t, employees))\n\tif code != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit = %d, want want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileRowOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runCLI(t, writeCSV(t, employees))\n\tif code != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit = %d, want 0\", code)\n\t}\n\trecords :=
